en.title: Changelog entries as one file per change
en.body: A change adds its entry as `changes/<name>.json`, with the date and a title and a body in English and in Chinese, instead of editing the two changelogs; two pull requests then never write the same lines, which GitHub's own merge could not resolve. `node tools/changelog.mjs` checks the waiting entries and runs with the tests; `node tools/changelog.mjs --fold` puts them at the top of both changelogs, newest first, and removes their files, as a change of its own made from time to time. The provenance ledger takes an entry as it takes a contribution declaration. A blank line lost between two entries by an earlier union merge is put back.

zh.title: 更新日志条目改为每个改动一个文件
zh.body: 一个改动把它的条目写成 `changes/<名称>.json`，包含日期以及英文和中文的标题与正文，不再直接修改两个更新日志；这样两个 PR 永远不会改同一行，GitHub 自己的合并也就不会再冲突。`node tools/changelog.mjs` 检查待合入的条目，并随测试运行；`node tools/changelog.mjs --fold` 把它们按日期从新到旧放到两个更新日志的顶部并删除文件，这一步作为单独的改动不定期进行。来源登记像对待贡献声明一样接受条目。之前一次 union 合并丢掉的两个条目之间的空行也已补回。
